title: Validity, Expiry and Retention Periods of Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
Three Gift Cards & Store Credit types expire and three never do. Where a type expires, its expiry date is fixed when it is issued, either from the holder's Marlowe Rewards tier or as a fixed number of calendar days counted from the valid-from date; the valid-from date is the issue date plus the type's valid-from delay. An expiring instrument stops working at the end of its expiry date, Eastern Time.

## Periods by instrument type

| Instrument type | Expires | How the expiry date is set | Validity days counted from the valid-from date | Valid-from delay (calendar days after issue) | Depleted retention (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | Yes | Rewards Note validity days of the Marlowe Rewards tier | 0 (not used) | 0 | 30 |
| Bonus Gift Card | Yes | Fixed days from the valid-from date | 45 | 14 | 30 |
| Goodwill Credit | Yes | Fixed days from the valid-from date | 365 | 0 | 30 |
| Return Store Credit | No | No expiry | 0 (not used) | 0 | 365 |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | No | No expiry | 0 (not used) | 0 | 365 |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | No | No expiry | 0 (not used) | 0 | 365 |

**Expiry cut-off, all types:** end of the expiry date, Eastern Time.

**Depleted retention** is the number of calendar days a depleted instrument stays open for refunds before it closes.

## Worked dates (hypothetical instruments)

| Hypothetical instrument | Issue date | Valid-from date | Expiry date | Last moment it works |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bonus Gift Card | 1 December 2025 | 15 December 2025 (14 days after issue) | 29 January 2026 (45 days after 15 December) | End of 29 January 2026, Eastern Time |
| Goodwill Credit | 10 March 2025 | 10 March 2025 (no delay) | 10 March 2026 (365 days after 10 March 2025) | End of 10 March 2026, Eastern Time |
| Return Store Credit | any date | the issue date | none | no expiry |

A Bonus Gift Card therefore has a valid-from date two weeks after its issue date, while every other Gift Cards & Store Credit type is valid from the day it is issued.
